scope: Source-certified automatic compound PRIMARY/UNIQUE indexes on rowid tables: actual declaration order, tuple programs, NULL catalog SQL, PK ordinals, rowid/STRICT/collation behavior, transactions and independent rollback/WAL files. Finite admitted cases, not global SQLite equivalence.

negative_results.reason: Compound PRIMARY/UNIQUE declarations and native automatic compound index files were rejected.
The concrete grammar certificate still required singleton table keys, preventing actual compound source retention and independent acquisition.
Data, automatic catalog records and unique actions matched; the detailed table-info path still read internal single-key metadata rather than actual compound PK ordinals.

negative_results.stage: Shared metadata and continuing API preview
negative_results.reason: The basic actual automatic-source, rowid, table/index metadata and recovery paths match.

INTEGER components of compound STRICT keys still received the singleton rowid-alias NULL exemption, and two old admission guards rejected compound collated UNIQUE keys. Both runtime NOT NULL semantics and actual metadata/admission were fixed.

implementation: CoreAutoIndexSpec derives actual declaration order, key coalescing, PRIMARY origin and automatic numbers. Concrete grammar matching checks every key token, collation and direction metadata position.

IndexOrigin stores the actual CREATE TABLE source, a proof that its specification belongs to that parsed declaration and exact emitted key-program equality. Preparation checks the same source against its actual owner; independent acquisition reconstructs it from that owner.

The source-aware CREATE path constructs the real rowid table and ordinary indexes, retains the original declaration and attaches automatic tuple programs before publication. The source-free single-command AST model rejects compound constraints; its refinement relation explicitly includes that admission premise.

Automatic entries encode actual NULL catalog SQL. Object checks require the same actual table source, and the independent physical decoder checks every tuple field and rowid. Mixed ordinary/compound automatic identities follow actual declaration order.

Actual source metadata provides PK ordinals and pk/u origin through direct and virtual PRAGMAs. Nullable ordinary compound PKs remain nullable; all compound STRICT components, including INTEGER, are NOT NULL. Existing tuple comparisons and actual point/victim semantics implement conflict effects. The C VFS shim is unchanged.

evaluation_protocols.public_file_modes: 7704 complete stdout/exit/first-error and independent persisted catalog/row/integrity comparisons, including 90 compound table-key cases, fresh generated values, native-origin files, mixed/merged automatic keys, STRICT, collations and metadata.
evaluation_protocols.same_connection: 316 actual continuation cases: 167 general, 29 partial, 27 expression, 31 collated, 30 explicit composite and 32 new automatic-table cases, reported separately.
evaluation_protocols.crashes: 468 finite SIGKILL timing samples, including 24 new automatic compound-key samples; actual production recovery followed by independent SQLite schema/row/index-key/cookie/integrity observations. No every-syscall, power-loss, arbitrary-schedule or global root identity claim.
evaluation_protocols.named_features: The original 88-probe survey decreases from four failures to two: WITHOUT ROWID in both file modes. This finite survey is not a global coverage percentage.

proof_scope: All retained contracts and required audits compile. The newly audited automaticIndex_table law applies to the actual proof-carrying automatic-index constructor; its fields certify membership in the actual parsed table specifications and exact emitted program text. Independent checked-image/journal contracts execute the full tuple validator. The maintained new group checks actual automatic origin, source-free rejection, public PK ordinals, real rowid replacement and pk metadata. The single-command translated-write theorem now explicitly excludes compound programs, matching its actual admission boundary. No global table-constraint/SQL/planner equivalence theorem is claimed.
limitations: The original survey still fails WITHOUT ROWID in both file modes.

Descending keys, non-ABORT compound declaration policies, singleton collated PRIMARY/UNIQUE combinations, auxiliary planner/foreign-parent admission, recursive auxiliary REPLACE with DELETE programs, ALTER, UPSERT, UTF-16 auxiliary index IO and broader scalar error/phase combinations remain work.
Bulk physical root-page layout is not globally SQLite-identical; pending new-object schema metadata and larger root-preservation cases remain separate work.
Wider error codes/phases, FAIL/IGNORE/ROLLBACK controls, triggered UPSERT, INSTEAD OF/temp triggers, writable CTEs, trigger-aware ALTER and deferred private-function declarations remain work.

UTF-16 writes/setters, native-key/materialization limits, pending new physical allocations and earlier SQL/storage limitations remain. The finite process-kill samples do not establish every syscall/power-loss schedule.
